- "We care more about perceived latency than absolute token cost" — quote from VP Product; implies streaming + predictable tail latency are highest priority.
- POC notes: captured Fireflies IDs, SE ran a synthetic 200 concurrent-chat session test; observed batching makes costs drop but increases tail latency if not coupled with streaming windows. Marisol suggested continuous batching windows + prefix caching.
- Next: deliver POC metrics dashboard (token-level latency, per-route error rate), present Dedicated pricing tiers tailored to 100-300 RPS sustained, follow up with procurement and legal.
